# European Centre for Algorithmic Transparency

> The European Centre for Algorithmic Transparency (ECAT) is the EU's authoritative research institution for studying algorithmic systems, platform regulation, and the Digital Services Act enforcement.

ECAT operates as part of the Joint Research Centre to advance scientific understanding of algorithmic transparency, online platform accountability, and systemic risks in digital services. The centre conducts research, provides data access to researchers, and engages with EU policymakers and Very Large Online Platforms on DSA compliance and algorithmic auditing.

## Key Topics

- European Centre for Algorithmic Transparency (ECAT)
- Digital Services Act (DSA)
- Very Large Online Platforms (VLOPs)
- Algorithmic Transparency
- Platform Regulation
- Researcher Data Access
- AI and Algorithmic Systems
- Systemic Risks
- Online Platform Supervision
- EU Policy
- Platform Accountability
- Algorithmic Bias
- Disinformation
- Joint Research Centre (JRC)
- European Commission
